name: Seduce Me: Shall We Dance?
source:
"I Want To Be Worthy Of You."

Sam and I have been living together for almost 2 years. He’s worked in the Police Force and I couldn't be happier.

Why did Sam want me to wear this dress, though, and where was he taking me?

[From [url=http://thebunnyofevil.tumblr.com/post/112492883511/seduce-me-shall-we-dance-i-want-to-be-worthy-of]official site[/url]]

Epilogue for Sam's route.
translation:
“我想成为配得上你的人。”

我和山姆一起生活快两年了。他在警察部门工作，我对此幸福无比。

可是，山姆为什么要我穿上这条裙子？他又要带我去哪里？
